profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Belcan Engineering
profile.summary: Analytical Programmer who possesses strong knowledge of Object Oriented programming. Quickly masters new software packages and hardware technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Facilitate Prototype software development on Linux-based engine simulators.
• Develop innovation strategies, processes, and best practices.
• Promote and support company policies, procedures, mission, values, and standards of ethics and integrity.
• Develop software and perform integration for flight control products.
• Develop Requirements Based Test Procedures and perform requirements based verification including structural coverage analysis.
• Plan and perform Formal Qualification Tests

positions.title: Mobile App Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed, built and maintained Medrills Interactive Training Applications modules (iOS).
•	Developed the Diabetes Education (interactive game in iOS).
•	Developed the ART (Assisted Reproductive Technology) calculator(iOS).
•	Developed the KnowNAS (Neonatal Abstinence Score) calculator(iOS).

positions.title: Quality Assurance Tester Intern
positions.description: •	Built and tested the Medrills Interactive Training Applications on various platforms, including iOS, Android and Flash web pages.

positions.title: DSL CPE Technician
positions.description:
•	Performed onsite DSL installations and repairs for AT&T residential and business customers.
•	Installed, configured and maintained small networks for small business customers.
